In this blog we delve deeper into the concept of AI cryptocurrencies, what they are, the practical functionalities provided, what they may bring and what are the main challenges. As well as how they can bolster the crypto industry and its adoption in mainstream finance. What are AI Cryptocurrencies? Artificial Intelligence (AI) cryptocurrencies, sometimes named coins, are digital assets linked to blockchain projects that

to enhance their functionality, security and overall performance. They operate at the intersection of blockchain technology and artificial intelligence. These digital assets function as utility tokens within AI-based projects, applications, and services. These currencies often feature AI-powered predictive models, automated trading systems, and smart contract platforms. AI cryptocurrencies are designed to power blockchain-based platforms such as decentralized AI marketplaces or exchanges by leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) technology and machine learning and automation that could power everything from AI-driven applications and services to decentralized networks and autonomous systems. In contrast to regular cryptocurrencies, which primarily function as a medium of trade, AI coins use sophisticated AI and machine learning algorithms that can automate trading procedures, analyse data, and forecast market movements. The combination of AI and cryptocurrency aims to leverage massive data processing and continuous learning capabilities to create a more efficient trading environment and services. What are the use cases for AI Cryptocurrencies While Bitcoin and other traditional cryptocurrencies were created to be digital money, these new AI-focused cryptocurrencies do something different. They aren't just for trading – they're designed to help manage and run AI technology and power the next generation of AI infrastructure and services, from decentralized computing networks to secure data marketplaces. AI cryptocurrencies can be used to access AI services, purchase AI models, or participate in governance. They either directly power AI platforms and services or support the broader AI ecosystem through data sharing, computing power, or other means  Everything happens automatically through the blockchain without the need of intermediaries. The main function of these tokens is to facilitate access to and utilize AI-related services and resources within a decentralized ecosystem such as access to  AI models, computing power, or data. They enable transactions and interactions within AI-focused platforms and marketplaces, fostering a transparent and trustless environment for the exchange of AI services, data, and model. AI tokens can be used to purchase computing power for training and deploying AI models. People or organizations with spare computing power can "rent" it out to others who need it, getting paid in these tokens. These tokens may confer governance rights on their holders, or they are needed to pay for transactions on the AI platform They could also be used to manage and share data securely, access datasets for machine learning. AI needs lots of data to work well, and these cryptocurrencies can help track who owns what data and who can use it and ensure people get paid fairly when their data is used to train AI systems. Or participate in decentralised market places. They could help to create decentralized AI networks. where thousands of computers worldwide can work together to train and run AI models.
